SELECT
        hp.id,
        st.store_name,
        ro.order_id,
        ro.prod_id,
        ro.qty,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN hp.return_mode = 5 AND hp.status = 'EXCHANGE_COMPLETED' THEN tmh.added_amt
            ELSE arl.refunded_amt
        END) AS pay_amount_refunded,
        CASE
            WHEN hp.return_mode = 5 AND hp.status = 'EXCHANGE_COMPLETED' THEN 'TSS_MONEY'
            ELSE arl.refund_mode
        END AS pay_amount_refunded_mode,
        rpr.reason,
        sr.sub_reason,
        ro.comment,
        hp.created_at as order_date,
        ro.created_at,
        o.parent_order_id AS OriginalOrderId
    FROM
        has_products AS hp
            LEFT JOIN
        return_orders AS ro ON ro.order_id = hp.order_id
            AND ro.prod_id = hp.prod_id AND ro.has_product_id = hp.id
            LEFT JOIN
        amount_to_be_refunded_log AS arl ON arl.order_id = ro.order_id
            AND arl.prod_id = ro.prod_id AND arl.has_product_id = hp.id
            LEFT JOIN
        reverse_pickup_reason AS rpr ON rpr.id = ro.reason_id
            LEFT JOIN
        sub_reasons AS sr ON sr.id = ro.sub_reason_id
            LEFT JOIN
        stores AS st ON st.id = ro.store_id
            LEFT JOIN
        orders AS o ON o.id = hp.order_id
            LEFT JOIN
        tss_money_history tmh ON tmh.order_id = o.id AND tmh.has_product_id = hp.id
                AND tmh.platform = 'EXCHANGE' AND tmh.added_amt > 0
    WHERE
        (hp.return_mode = 3 OR (hp.return_mode = 5 AND hp.status = 'EXCHANGE_COMPLETED'))
            AND ro.store_id > 0
 AND ro.created_at BETWEEN '2026-11-16 00:00:00' AND '2026-11-16 23:59:59' AND ro.store_id IN (1) GROUP BY hp.id ORDER BY ro.created_at DESC,hp.id ASC

SELECT
                st.store_name AS Store_Name,
                sp.employee_id AS employee_id,
                CONCAT(sp.first_name, ' ', sp.last_name) AS salesperson_name,
                SUM(hp.price) AS total_sales
            FROM
                order_stores os
                    LEFT JOIN
                has_products hp ON os.order_id = hp.order_id
                    LEFT JOIN
                salespersons sp ON sp.id = (
                CASE WHEN hp.salesperson_id = 0 THEN os.salesperson_id
                ELSE hp.salesperson_id
                END)
                    LEFT JOIN
                stores st ON st.id = os.store_id
            WHERE
                hp.`status` = 'DELIVERED'
                AND NULLIF(sp.employee_id, '') IS NOT NULL
         AND hp.created_at BETWEEN '2026-11-16 00:00:00' AND '2026-11-16 23:59:59' AND os.store_id IN (1) GROUP BY employee_id ORDER BY total_sales DESC,employee_id ASC

SELECT 
                os.admin_user_id as pos_admin_id,
                os.performance_json,
                CONCAT(u.firstname, ' ', u.lastname) AS cashier_name,
                sum(hp.qty) as qty,
                os.order_id as oi
            FROM
                orders o
                    LEFT JOIN
                order_stores os ON os.order_id = o.id
                    LEFT JOIN
                users u on u.id = os.admin_user_id
                    LEFT JOIN has_products hp on hp.order_id = o.id
            WHERE
                NULLIF(performance_json, '') IS NOT NULL
         AND o.created_at BETWEEN '2026-11-16 00:00:00' AND '2026-11-16 23:59:59' AND os.store_id IN (1) GROUP BY os.order_id ORDER BY os.order_id ASC

SELECT
                    hol.id,
                    s.store_name,
                    hol.order_id,
                    pos_admin_id,
                    hol.created_at,
                    CONCAT(
                        CASE
                            WHEN FLOOR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, hol.created_at, hol.updated_at) / 86400) > 0
                            THEN CONCAT(FLOOR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, hol.created_at, hol.updated_at) / 86400), 'D ')
                            ELSE ''
                        END,
                        FLOOR((TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, hol.created_at, hol.updated_at) % 86400) / 3600), 'H ',
                        FLOOR((TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, hol.created_at, hol.updated_at) % 3600) / 60), 'M ',
                        (TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, hol.created_at, hol.updated_at) % 60), 'S'
                    ) AS time_taken
                FROM
                    hyperlocal_order_log hol
                        LEFT JOIN
                    orders o ON o.id = hol.order_id
                        Left JOIN
                    stores s on s.id = o.location_id
                WHERE
                    hol.action = 'accepted'
         AND hol.created_at BETWEEN '2026-11-16 00:00:00' AND '2026-11-16 23:59:59' AND o.location_id IN (1) ORDER BY hol.id
